subject: Privacy evidence, e-signature & onboarding paperwork for Starlift
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@starlift.net
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-27T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Privacy evidence, e-signature & onboarding paperwork for Starlift

Hi Alex / Starlift procurement team,

Thanks for the productive kickoff yesterday. Procurement needs to get a few mandatory artifacts in place to complete vendor activation and route the PO. Could you please provide the following items so we can move to an executed agreement and PO issuance?

- Executed Data Processing Agreement (we prefer DocuSign) — please send the signer name and a link when ready.
- SOC 2 Type II report (or hosting of a download link) — latest report for 2027 or 2028 is fine.
- Completed subprocessor list in CSV (we need company, region, data access type, and contract date).
- Billing contact, remit-to email, and any PO/invoice instructions (Redwood requires PO number before first invoice).

I've attached our onboarding checklist to show the required fields and expected order. If you anticipate any compliance redlines on the DPA, flag them now so we can route to Legal. Our target timeline is: DPA signed + subprocessor CSV by EOD Friday 5/31, PO raised by Monday 6/3. Is that feasible on your side?

Quick note: procurement will want the Data Deletion timeline in Section 4 nailed down (default is 30 days). If you need an alternate, mention it in your response.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (1 page, checklist)

From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@starlift.net>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@starlift.net
Date: 2028-05-27T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy evidence, e-signature & onboarding paperwork for Starlift

Hi Mateo,

Appreciate the list — we've pulled everything together and can start the sign/transfer flow. Quick summary below: 

1) SOC 2: public link to our latest Type II (2027) is here: https://starlift.s3.amazonaws.com/security/SOC2-TypeII-2027.pdf
2) Subprocessor list: attached CSV (starlift-subprocessor-list.csv) — columns included per your template.
3) DPA: our legal can sign via DocuSign. I can route to our signatory, Jordan Li (General Counsel). We'll send back a DocuSign link; if Redwood requires a specific routing order (Sales -> Legal -> Procurement), say the word.
4) Billing: billing@starlift.net is the remit-to; they requested a PO number and Redwood tax ID. If you can share the PO template, we'll fill in vendor fields and return.

One quick question: in Section 4 you mentioned a 30-day deletion window. Our standard is 45 days for deprovision and data purge. Are you able to accept 45 days? If not, flag the exact concern and we'll follow up with Legal.

I'll attach the CSV and a short billing note. Expect DocuSign within the next 2 business hours.

Best,
Alex Morton
Senior Procurement Lead | Starlift Networks
Alex.Morton@starlift.net

Attachment: starlift-subprocessor-list.csv (3 KB)
Attachment: billing-note.txt (1 page)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morton <alex.morton@starlift.net>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-28T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy evidence, e-signature & onboarding paperwork for Starlift

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and the links. Two short items from Redwood Sales/Legal side: 

- We reviewed the subprocessor CSV; looks complete for first pass. Our privacy team may ping for clarification on one EU subprocessor's data residency.
- DPA redline: Redwood Legal typically approves a 45-day deletion term only in special cases; our standard is 30 days. That said, for platform partners we can make a single-issue exception if the vendor covenants no persistent backups beyond the purge window and accepts audit requests. Can Starlift agree to 45 days with a covenant around backup retention and audit cooperation? If yes, Legal will sign off and we can proceed to DocuSign.

Attached is our PO template to speed invoicing once the DPA is executed. When the DocuSign link is ready, share it and I'll route internally for signature.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO-template-redwood.pdf (1 page)

From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@starlift.net>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-28T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy evidence, e-signature & onboarding paperwork for Starlift

Ben / Mateo — thanks for the clarification. Jordan in Legal confirmed Starlift can accept the 45-day deletion window provided Redwood includes the backup covenant language. We'll sign once the covenant is present.

Actions completed on our end: 
- DocuSign link for the DPA: https://na1.docusign.net/StaRLiFT-DPA-ESIGN-abcdef (Jordan Li is routing).
- Attached final subprocessor CSV (same as earlier).
- Billing: billing@starlift.net; remit-to: Starlift Networks, Inc.; wire instructions sent to the billing contact separately. They asked only for Redwood's PO# and Redwood tax ID for the invoice.

If you can confirm Redwood will add the backup covenant clause (we're happy to propose wording), we'll finalize signature within the hour. Otherwise we'll proceed with the default and note the exception.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Morton
Senior Procurement Lead | Starlift Networks

Attachment: invoice-instructions.txt (banking note)
